us.title: Storms and coastal flooding could slow Thanksgiving travel plans
us.desc: Thanksgiving travel could be slow-going over the next few days with storms and coastal flooding expected on both sides of the U.S. Kris Van Cleave reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

us.title: Latino-Owned Coffee Shop Closes After Claims That Founder Works for ICE
us.desc: Tasa Coffee Roasters in Chicago permanently closed its doors after workers walked out in protest.
